subject: EVS
learning_goal: Master the chapter content using source-grounded explanations, practice and revision.

sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: The Blue Planet “After seeing the Earth from outside the first thought that came to mind was that, the Earth looks completely one, no border is visible from outside.
sections.source_evidence: The Blue Planet “After seeing the Earth from outside the first thought that came to mind was that, the Earth looks completely one, no border is visible from outside.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: It seems that no border exists, no state exists, no countries exist.
sections.source_evidence: It seems that no border exists, no state exists, no countries exist.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: We all are part of humanity and the Earth is our one home, and all of us are in it.” These were the inspiring words shared by Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian to reach the International Space Station, during his conversation with the then Prime Minister of India.
sections.source_evidence: We all are part of humanity and the Earth is our one home, and all of us are in it.” These were the inspiring words shared by Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian to reach the International Space Station, during his conversation with the then Prime Minister of India.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Earth — Our Shared Home 10 Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma, the Indian astronaut, was the first Indian to see the Earth from space.
sections.source_evidence: Earth — Our Shared Home 10 Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma, the Indian astronaut, was the first Indian to see the Earth from space.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: When asked how India looked from above, he replied, “Saare Jahaan Se Achcha” (the best in the entire world).
sections.source_evidence: When asked how India looked from above, he replied, “Saare Jahaan Se Achcha” (the best in the entire world).

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Our Wondrous World 162 From high up in space, the Earth looks tiny and we would not be able to see smaller details like our city or village.
sections.source_evidence: Our Wondrous World 162 From high up in space, the Earth looks tiny and we would not be able to see smaller details like our city or village.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: We only see the broad shapes of land masses and the sea on our blue planet.
sections.source_evidence: We only see the broad shapes of land masses and the sea on our blue planet.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Activity 1 We all live in this planet and each of us has an address.
sections.source_evidence: Activity 1 We all live in this planet and each of us has an address.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: My address Name: House number/building name: Street name: Village/Town/City: District: State/Union Territory: Country: Planet: 2.
sections.source_evidence: My address Name: House number/building name: Street name: Village/Town/City: District: State/Union Territory: Country: Planet: 2.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Are all the oceans on Earth connected with each other? b.
sections.source_evidence: Are all the oceans on Earth connected with each other? b.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: 163 Earth — Our Shared Home DIGIPIN is like a digital version of your address!
sections.source_evidence: 163 Earth — Our Shared Home DIGIPIN is like a digital version of your address!

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: It gives every small place in India its own special 10-character digital code.
sections.source_evidence: It gives every small place in India its own special 10-character digital code.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: It is like a name tag for your home or school.
sections.source_evidence: It is like a name tag for your home or school.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: It helps the postman, ambulance or delivery person find you faster even in villages or cities!
sections.source_evidence: It helps the postman, ambulance or delivery person find you faster even in villages or cities!

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: When we look at the Earth from far above, we do not see borders or lines between countries.
sections.source_evidence: When we look at the Earth from far above, we do not see borders or lines between countries.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Nature has no boundaries — so air, water, clouds, and even seeds and animals move freely across the world.
sections.source_evidence: Nature has no boundaries — so air, water, clouds, and even seeds and animals move freely across the world.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: People around the world are also connected in many ways.
sections.source_evidence: People around the world are also connected in many ways.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: Just as people across India share mangoes, rivers, and festivals, people across the world are also linked by the things we share.
sections.source_evidence: Just as people across India share mangoes, rivers, and festivals, people across the world are also linked by the things we share.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: The clothes we wear, the food we eat, and the toys we play with may have come from different parts of the world.
sections.source_evidence: The clothes we wear, the food we eat, and the toys we play with may have come from different parts of the world.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: Ideas, food, music, stories, and inventions are also shared.
sections.source_evidence: Ideas, food, music, stories, and inventions are also shared.
